# hostwarden_schedule (Resource)

Scheduled snapshots or backups of a virtual machine, run by the Hostwarden server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `frequency` (String) hourly (at minute), daily (at hour:minute) or weekly (on weekday at hour:minute).
- `kind` (String) snapshot or backup.
- `vm_id` (String) The virtual machine (hostwarden_vm id).

### Optional

- `backup_datastore` (String) Kind backup: datastore of the VM's host the backup is written to.
- `backup_target_datastore` (String) Kind backup: datastore on backup_target_host_id.
- `backup_target_host_id` (String) Kind backup: move each backup to this other host (optional).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule runs (default true).
- `hour` (Number) Hour of the day, 0-23 (default 0). Used by daily and weekly.
- `keep` (Number) Scheduled snapshots or backups to keep; older ones are removed (default 0 = all).
- `minute` (Number) Minute, 0-59 (default 0).
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone the times are meant in, e.g. Europe/Rome (default UTC).
- `weekday` (Number) Day of the week, 0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday (default 0). Used by weekly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
